app.title: Sunspill: where the sun lands in your room
app.tagline: Draw a room, scrub the clock, see the sun cross the floor.
view.label: View
stage.hint: Drag to turn the room. Drag furniture and windows to move them.
stage.ariaSun: The sun is {el} degrees up to the {dir} and {area} of floor is in direct sun.
stage.ariaNight: The sun is below the horizon.
dock.polarNight: The sun does not rise on this date here.
room.thicknessNote: Thick walls trim the sun that arrives at an angle, so the patch is smaller than the opening.
room.dial: Compass direction of the selected window
room.orientNote: Turn the dial to the direction you see when you stand at the window and look out. North is up.
room.compassHint: Point the top of the phone out of the window and hold still.
room.compassSet: Window set to face {dir}. Phone compasses read magnetic north.
room.compassDenied: The compass is not available here.
win.title: Windows
win.name: Window {n}
win.none: No windows: the room stays dark.
win.acrossOn: A building blocks part of the sky
place.title: Where the room is
place.denied: Could not read your location. Search a city instead.
place.name: Name shown on pictures
place.zone: Time zone (name such as Asia/Taipei, or UTC+8)
place.zoneBad: That time zone is not known.
place.summary: Showing {date}. Change the date under the room.
place.note: Cities come from a list inside this page and your location stays in your browser. Nothing is sent anywhere.
things.title: Furniture and plants
things.note: Drag a piece on the floor. Its top shows the sun that reaches it. Furniture does not cast shadows in this version.
things.max: That is the most pieces the room holds.
things.sunTop: Sun reaches the top for {t} on {date}
results.heatNote: Average hours of direct sun per day. Sample days: {n}.
results.legend: Hours of direct sun per day
tip.spot: {x} from the left, {y} from the bottom: {t}
results.westRule: Rule: on sample days from {from} to {to}, count the minutes after {after} when direct sun reaches the floor or a wall, and average them per day.
results.westLine: of direct sun inside per day after {after}
plant.title: Where a plant gets its light
plant.rule: Rule: the whole 30 cm footprint must fall in the chosen light level, using the period set under Sun hours map. Best spots first, at least 60 cm apart.
plant.none: No spot matches. Try another period or another light level.
plant.spot: {x} from the left, {y} from the bottom: {t} a day
share.title: Share this room
share.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the link and copy it by hand.
share.hideNote: Rounds the place to whole degrees and drops its name in the link, the picture and the GIF.
share.noSun: The sun does not rise on this date here.
share.gifNote: Made in this page, 540 pixels wide, 12 frames a second, silent.
share.importFailed: That file is not a Sunspill room.
card.floorNow: Floor in sun at this moment: {area}
card.assume: Clear sky, direct sun only. No reflections, no furniture shadows.
foot.privacy: Nothing leaves this page after it loads.
card.of: of direct sun inside, from {from} to {to}
